programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country And western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to San Pablo, Mexico, to find out what's behind the trouble an American tungsten mine is having. When they arrive, they discover the mine has been closed, the wells are all poisoned and the town is in the grip of a malaria epidemic. To make matters worse, the lawmen have been followed by four gunslingers determined to give the American troubleshooters all the trouble they can handle - and more. Russell Hayden stars.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. Originally aired on NBC.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In an episode called Koniakers, G-Men Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett investigate how U.S. currency in a bank vault was replaced by counterfeit money. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West. In this episode, Pat and Stoney get reports that a man is selling salted mines to investors. The two G-men are determined to discover the truth. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate tries to teach Betty Jo how to make hot rhubarb after setting her up on a double date. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired November 12, 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Bank robbers stay the night at Shady Rest hoping to intercept a bank shipment on the Cannonball.Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Sherman Marks. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Uncle Joe is pelted with eggs after his team, the Hooterville Hornets, lose a game. Worse, Bedloe is back in town, which is never a good sign. It turns out Bedloe is planning a suroprise inspection with help frmo the railroad. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate hires Herby to work as an assistant manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: The bank is robbed and the sheriff is killed while everyone is distracted by the wedding between Sand Creeks newspaper editor and a beautiful brunette. The sheriff being the editors best man, the grief-stricken editor begins to escalate the anger towards a suspected drifter with his bias reporting. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie is on the case when homesteaders are forced to sell their land for cheap due to suspicious circumstances. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Tagg Oakley finds himself in trouble after being tricked into driving a wagon full of gunpowder to Fort Yuma, unaware that Geronimo and his Apache braves are waiting for the wagon to pass. Realizing Tagg is in danger, Annie and Lofty race to the rescue. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie writes to the son of an old female pedlar, unaware that he is a member of an outlaw gang, now on their way to Diablo. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Also starring Slim Pickens. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Mistaken for a notorious outlaw, a young man struggles to convince the townspeople that he didnt commit a stagecoach robbery. Initially, Annie and Susan Meriwether believe him, but his innocence comes into question when he is present during a bank robbery in which the outlaws seem to recognize him. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: With the sheriff off looking for an outlaw, a fake sheriff takes his place, leading to a senseless murder. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This enetertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Waiting to hear whether or not gold has been struck in the mine, Annie discovers a beloved stagecoach is being driven by the daughter of the owner, whos threatening to sell the stage so he can pocket the money. When word comes back that there is no gold in the money, Annie becomes suspicious and begins investigating. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: After a jailed Dobie escapes from jail, Dobie and Tagg find themselves kidnapped, forcing a desperate Annie to rescue her brother. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Loser's End
programme.desc: This spine-tingling drama of the west stars Jack Perrin as a man out for revenge against an outlaw gang. Other stars include Tina Menard as the woman who helps him along the way, and Elias Lazoroff as the daring Don Carlos. Perrin (Jaws of Justice, The Apache Kid's Escape), was a familiar face in low budget westerns, his career spanning back to the silent era.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: Clint Belmet (Gary Cooper) is a frontier scout with his hands full in this 1931 Paramount Pictures version of Zane Grey's novel. He's helping guide a wagon train across the country, fighting off various attacks on the way, and falling for his lovely Felice (Lily Damita). Belmet's grizzled companions think he should leave the woman alone, but it gets lonely out on the trail, and Felice's charms are hard to resist. Featuring such notable character actors of the period as Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, and Fred Kolher, this vintage Hollywood Western still packs a wallop!

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Outdoor and Nature
programme.desc: OUTDOOR And Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

programme.title: Brač (Supetar)
programme.desc: On Brač, famed for its white stone, Zlatni Rat beach, and Vidova Gora, we stopped in Supetar to taste tradition. Restaurateur Teo Dragičević served us šporka juha, mišanca, and vitalac—authentic island flavors rooted in Brač’s rich culinary heritage.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Rome
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Rome, Italy — a city of ancient ruins, grand monuments, and unforgettable food. She experiences daily Roman life, from enjoying cappuccino and cornetto at a local café to tasting classic pastas like cacio e pepe and pasta alla gricia. She visits local markets, enjoys a picnic at Villa Doria Pamphili, and discovers Rome’s iconic landmarks — the Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, and Pantheon — beautifully lit at night.

programme.title: Rick Steves Europe

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Death Metal Blasts Part 2
programme.desc: Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Flying V
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: Wishbone Ash - Live In Hamburg
programme.desc: Ein legendärer Auftritt einer Hardrock-Legende in Hamburg! Diese Aufnahme vereint frisches Material mit zeitlosen Klassikern. Eine musikalische Reise durch mehr als dreißig Jahre Rockgeschichte, die pure Energie und Nostalgie verspricht.

programme.title: The Haunting
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. After suffering several miscarriages a young couple start to lose hope of ever having a child. They believe their luck has changed when they find a baby on their door step, although the husband is a little wary. Strange things start to happen including the death of their nannies, the failure of their business and a fatal accident, causing even more paranoia in the husband.

programme.title: Fall Guy
programme.desc: Sammy and Austin are childhood friends who have always had each other’s backs right from their teenage years. Their friendship is made in heaven and they will sacrifice almost anything for each other in business, money and women, especially women.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Jealousy rears its ugly head and puts a couple's relationship in jeopardy when they invite guests to stay over in their home.

programme.title: What Truly Matters
programme.desc: A demanding job threatens a couple's anniversary plans and their relationship. Tension rises when one partners prioritizes work, leading to misunderstandings and surprise revelations.

programme.title: Again
programme.desc: Willing to give their love another chance, Nifemi and Seun work towards repairing a damaged marriage that just may never recover.

programme.title: Baby On Board
programme.desc: A couple go through all kinds of emotional highs and lows as they expect a new addition to the family.

programme.title: Make A Move
programme.desc: An ex-convict gets pulled back into her old ways when she takes on a job that leads to the murder of an innocent man. Things get further complicated when she finds herself involved with his son who is out seeking revenge.

programme.title: Grip
programme.desc: A wealthy man, who has vowed to never fall in love, meets a woman that refuses to fall for his charms, forcing him to re-evaluate his stance on relationships.

programme.title: Faithful Sin
programme.desc: A philandering married woman causes problems for both hers and her neighbour's marriages when she gets pregnant and doesn't know who the father of her child may be.

programme.title: Grease To Grace
programme.desc: Detola, a gifted young mechanic, fights to save her late father’s debt-ridden workshop while raising her siblings. When she sparks an unexpected connection with Jarvis, a billionaire heir, their love is tested by his manipulative ex-fiancée Mimi and his mother’s fierce disapproval.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: When soft spoken and timid Temisan’s world turns upside down and her former loving husband starts to abuse her physically and verbally. She starts to find a seething rage building up inside her.

programme.title: The Couple
programme.desc: A happily married couple face some challenges when the husband loses his job and a jealous friend makes it her mission to destroy their lives.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Cynthia is a single mother, haunted by bad dreams which she believes prevents her from finding love. She seeks help from a prophetess on the advise of her friends but soon finds out that she has been deceived.

programme.title: We Tha Boyz
programme.desc: Four jolly teenagers decide to help their friend, Tokunbo, in his plans to get the love of Chioma, however, a rival gang is also vying for her attention. Tokunbo’s parents go out of town and they decide to throw the ultimate house party to impress her. As simple as the plan seems, in reality however, they get in several problems in order to pull it off and end up almost ruining the house.

programme.title: Blast From The Past
programme.desc: A long-lost father reappears as a boyfriend. Confused, heartbroken, and desperate for answers, Emily must confront the mystery surrounding her father’s disappearance and his unexpected re-emergence.

programme.title: Private Place
programme.desc: Two couples, faced with trouble in their respective marriages, take drastic action to get back on track.

programme.title: Dying Of Love
programme.desc: When his marriage proposal is rejected due to his current finanacial position, Tunde struggles to bounce back and trust his partner, leaving the door open for other temptation to get in.

programme.title: The Church Boy
programme.desc: Ify and Andy's near-perfect relationship is threatened by the beautiful Leah. How far will this relationship stand the test of time?

programme.title: Love On A Budget
programme.desc: A chance encounter leads Lotanna and Nancy to each other, but their love is tested when real life issues and financial pressure gets in the middle of their romance.

programme.title: AMC Music Moments - Playlist 518
programme.desc: AMC presents music from the latest African artists.

programme.title: Shades Of Lies
programme.desc: Teni's ambitions get the best of her when she follows bad advices at work after her boss, Chief Maxwell, is involved in an accident. When Chief Maxwell's family suspect foul play, the police get involved and it becomes increasingly clear that there is more to Chief Maxwell's death than meets the eye.

programme.title: Reform
programme.desc: Two detectives are forced to team up with a sinister criminal to save the daughter of an important man. Can they put their differences aside for the mission?

programme.title: Love Stake
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Three friends place a bet on whoever successfully woos and gets the number of the first guy they meet on their dinner hangout. They each try different tricks to win, but soon the competition intensifies leading to drama.

programme.title: Ride To Love
programme.desc: A struggling tech entrepreneur's chaotic bus ride sparks an unlikely connection with the driver but an ex girlfriend's shocking revelation and family pressure force him to choose between his past and a chance at true love.

programme.title: Ghost Baby
programme.desc: A group of mischievous ghosts, led by a child, haunts a community causing mayhem everywhere, while dealing with their own supernatural issues.

programme.desc: Ensi hetkestä alkaen Käärmeenkantaja pitää katsojan otteessaan tässä järkyttävässä psykologisessa draamassa, jossa hulluuden logiikka ajaa tapahtumia kohti väistämätöntä kliimaksia. Sarjamurhaaja kulkee vapaana Oslossa.

programme.title: Kaiku
programme.desc: Poliisi Simon on avioeron jälkeen menettänyt huoltajuuden 6-vuotiaaseen poikaansa Louieen. Epätoivon vallassa hän sieppaa pojan ja vie hänet saarelle, missä he piiloutuvat autioon kesämökkiin. Simon haluaa vain viettää viimeisen rauhallisen loman kahden poikansa kanssa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Shoo Bre
programme.desc: Vaikka Oscar ja Elias varttuvat samoilla nuhruisilla nurkilla, heidän elämänsä ovat täysin erilaisia. Koulu loppuu pian, ja kumpikin haluaa vaikuttaa omaan tulevaisuuteensa. Silti mikään ei mene kuten he odottivat.

programme.title: Puss
programme.desc: Tukholman takakaduilla joukko kunnianhimoisia tyttöjä pyörittää pientä harrastajateatteria. Eräänä iltana he huomaavat kiinteistön omistajan hiippailevan teatterissa kamera kädessään - ja siitä käynnistyy 48 tunnin mittainen kaoottinen vyyhti täynnä juonitteluja ja kommelluksia.

programme.title: Triple Dare
programme.desc: Rebekka, Claudia ja Sofie ovat lukion 1. luokalla. Vaikka he ovat rippikoulun käyneitä, he huomaavat päivittäin olevansa lapsuuden ja aikuisuuden välimaastossa.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: Alone in Space
programme.desc: Ei niin kovin kaukaisessa tulevaisuudessa valtava avaruuslaiva Svea tekee matkaa mukanaan vain kaksi matkustajaa - 12-vuotias Gladys ja hänen pikkuveljensä Keaton.

programme.title: Rosa Morena
programme.desc: Thomas on lähtenyt Brasiliaan lomalle, mutta asiaan liittyykin jotain muuta. Thomas nimittäin kaipaa kovasti erästä asiaa: hän haluaa tulla isäksi.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: The King Of Ping Pong
programme.desc: Rille ja Erik asuvat äidin kanssa, jonka pojat aavistavat olevan suhteessa Gunnariin - mitä he eivät hyväksy. Talvilomalla Rille järjestää pöytätennisturnauksen nuorisotalolla, mutta kun isä ilmestyy, Rillellä on paljon muuta mielessä.

programme.title: Original
programme.desc: Henry on elämän kalpea kopio. Nuori pankkivirkailija yrittää niin innokkaasti sopeutua muiden odotuksiin, että hän on jo kauan sitten kadottanut itsensä. Sitten Jon ilmestyy tyhjästä ja houkuttelee Henryn lähtemään mukaan Espanjaan avaamaan aidon bodegan.

programme.title: Leningrad Cowboys go America
programme.desc: Leningrad Cowboys Go America kertoo maailman huonoimman rock-yhtyeen matkasta Siperian tundralta Yhdysvaltojen kautta Meksikoon despoottisen managerinsa Vladimirin (Matti Pellonpää) johdolla. Elokuvasta sukeutui kansainvälinen menestys ja se nosti Leningrad Cowboys -yhtyeen maailmanmaineeseen.

programme.title: Umeå4Ever
programme.desc: Stian on 31-vuotias, hän on pitkään etsinyt rakkautta ja vähitellen laskenut vaatimuksiaan niin paljon, että on valmis tyytymään naiseen, joka huolii hänet.

programme.title: Pyromaani
programme.desc: Pyromaani sytyttää ensimmäisen tulipalonsa pienessä kylässä. Yhä isommat ja vaarallisemmat palot levittävät pelkoa pienessä yhteisössä.

programme.title: Kaalbringenin Kurkunleikkaaja
programme.desc: Jossain piileksii murhaaja, jonka itseluottamus kasvaa hetki hetkeltä. Pieni eurooppalainen rannikkokaupunki, Kaalbringen, on kauhun vallassa. Kuten myös Maardam. Lyhyen ajan sisällä kaupunkeja on järkyttänyt kaksi raakaa murhaa. Missä ja milloin ”kurkunleikkaaja” iskee seuraavaksi?

programme.title: Ruotsalainen Avioliitto
programme.desc: Erland on töissä pikkupaikkakunnan paperitehtaassa parhaan ystävänsä Sven-Erikin kanssa. Vapaa-aikana hän pitää seurakunnan avioliittokoulua yhdessä vaimonsa Mayn kanssa. Eräissä juhlissa Erland rakastuu tulisesti Sven-Erikin vaimoon Kariniin.

programme.title: Helmiä Ja Sikoja
programme.desc: Hirvoset, neljä veljestä ja isäukko, elelevätJoensuun Rantakylässä ja pyörittävätpienimuotoista bisnestä Pimeetä viinaa japikkusuolasta.

programme.title: Over The Edge
programme.desc: David ja Freja ovat mielettömän rakastuneita ja muuttavat unelmataloonsa Mønin saarelle. Pian idylli särkyy selittämättömän itsemurhan jälkeen. David päättää selvittää mysteerin, mutta mitä lähemmäs totuutta hän pääsee, sitä kauemmas hän etääntyy Frejasta.

programme.title: I Miss You
programme.desc: Identtiset kaksoset Cilla jaTina ovat hyvin läheiset mutta samalla valtavan erilaiset. Cilla on taiteilijasielu ja idealisti, joka kulkee omia teitään, kun taas Tina on suosittu, puberteettinen ja jatkuvasti rakastunut.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Anti
programme.desc: On vuosi 1991. Simon ja hänen paras kaverinsa Frede asuvat pikkupaikkakunnalla Kööpenhaminan lähistöllä toivomatta tulevaisuudelta muuta kuin uutta sätkää. Simon on aina pitänyt piirtämisestä, muttei ole koskaan ajatellut, että taidosta olisi jotain hyötyä.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 1
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Beyond Dreams
programme.desc: Mirja (Evin Ahmad) etsii paikkaansa maailmassa vankilasta päästyään. Saatuaan töitä hotellisiivoojana hän alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Hänen sairas äitinsä ja vanhat ystävänsä, jotka ovat olleet hänen oikea perheensä, repivät häntä kahtaalle.

Then, in a nearby park, Darrin overhears two squirrels to which Endora has given voice talk about their dif-ferences in age. Endora finally admits to Samantha that she can age along with Darrin. Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the Maid of Salem disappear.

programme.title: Dancin' Angels
programme.desc: A dance marathon with $5,000 in prize money attracts Joe and Sally Fairgate to compete, but when Sally disappears, Joe enlists the Angels' help in finding her. They investigate and question suspects, promoter P.J. Wilkes, investor Al Norman and leading dance couple, Steve and Jenny. Bosley discovers that Norman is a small time racketeer and Steve is a convicted hood from New York. The Angels approach the suspects to find motives for Sally's murder, making Wilkes and Norman very nervous. But when dance band singer, Billy, is found dead after an altercation with band leader Elton Mills, Kelly mistakenly confronts Mills, who confines her until he can kill her later. Wilkes and Norman admit moving Sally's body after Mills killed her. The Angels busy themselves searching for Kelly. She escapes from Mills and following a brief shootout, he is captured by the Angels, ending his attempt at a comeback as a dance band leader.

programme.title: Harrigan's Angel
programme.desc: When Starrett Electronics is the victim of a second large heist, Paul Starrett's insurance company insists he have additional help for Joseph Harrigan, a bumbling, disheveled private investigator covering the case. The Angels investigation develops leads and they question photo engraver Belkin materials and shipper Felber, who both have police records linked to Starrett. Kris and Harrigan figured out the heist method but Starrett has already ordered them killed. The Angels confront and arrest Starrett for robbing his own business. They then rush to Harrigan's apartment in time to capture Felber and Belkin attempting to kill Harrigan.

programme.title: An Angel's Trail
programme.desc: Jill Munroe is taken hostage when she accidentally stumbles into a gas station robbery. Convict Sam Mason and his sons, Clint and Harley, escape into the desolate desert hills keeping Jill tied in the back of their getaway van. Tiffany researches the geography of the highlands and discovers an old road overlooked by the search party. Hampered by wind and rain, Kris continues to lead the search for her sister when they find indications that the convicts are nearby. Jill befriends the retarded Harley who retaliates against his cruel father by battering Sam unconscious -- saving Jill from certain death. Jill sees that Harley receives special attention in the best institution for the mentally handicapped.

programme.title: Nips And Tucks
programme.desc: When a Congressional witness is found dead, the Angels investigate plastic surgeon Paul Redmont's association with racketeer Vern Maddox, who they learn wants plastic surgery to change his identity. Kris and Bosley pose as a couple seeking cosmetic surgery for Bosley, while Tiffany gathers information posing as a nurse. Redmont's girlfriend and former revolutionary, Barbara Brown, arranges for Maddox's surgery. But when nurse Elena discovers Maddox's true identity as the million dollar swindler of government pension funds, Barbara kills her. Barbara then forces Tiffany to replace Elena during the surgery of Maddox and she blackmails Redmont into completing the operation. The other Angels burst into the operating room where they subdue and apprehend Barbara and Maddox and inform Redmont that his very professional work almost changed their suspect's identity.

programme.title: Three For The Money
programme.desc: When three unsuspecting investors are bilked by racketeer, Harley Dexter, the Angels scheme to con Dexter into returning the money. Kelly persuades Dexter to use laundered syndicate money to buy her truckload of Mayan artifacts; Kris works an ingenious switch of her worthless Rolls Royce for Dexter's Rolls and Tiffany poses as a Senator's aide demanding payment to stop the Senator's investigation of Dexter's syndicate ties. Dexter is ruined when the syndicate realizes that the Maya artifacts are phony. Kris Rolls Royce is junked and the Senator arranges a Grand Jury injunction against Dexter. The original investors receive their money and Dexter is last seen being cornered by his syndicate ties demanding their money.

programme.title: Toni's Boys
programme.desc: After a number of attempts on the Angels' lives, Charlie hires Antonia Blake to protect them. Toni's boys (Bob, Matt and Cotton) are expert detectives but the Angels resist their orders to stay undercover and not venture out of Toni's mansion. Racketeer Danny Flores is tipped off to the presence of an investigation in which Tiffany figures prominently. They are sleuthing his modeling agency so he captures her in hopes of drawing the other Angels around. The guys uncover Flores' winery, a front for a scheme to infiltrate an elite gathering but Flores recognizes Kris and Kelly as hostesses at this affair for the rich, and in an effort to save them, Toni's boys are forced to blow their cover. Flores' men overcome the guys and then proceed with their original plan to seal the Angels behind a brick wall where they will suffocate. Toni's boys storm the hacienda and wine cellar.

programme.title: One Love… Two Angels, Part 1
programme.desc: Part 1 -Kelly is thought to be the orphaned daughter of wealthy hotel owner, Oliver Barrows, whose search for his Margaret ends when the resemblance between Kelly and a huge oil portrait of Barrows' deceased wife is indistinguishable. Kelly is suddenly heir to the massive Barrows fortune, including the stately Barrows Hotel, which was scheduled to be donated to the city if no heir were found.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) And Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Vuoteen 1903 sijoittuva ihmisjahtidraama Jäljittäjä alkaa kun Arjan (Ray Winstone), Etelä-Afrikan buurisodista selviytynyt sissi, saapuu Uuden-Seelannin siirtokuntaan ja hänelle luvataan palkkio Kereaman (Temuera Morrison), sotilaan tappamisesta syytetyn maori merimiehen, kiinniottamisesta.

programme.title: Aika ei anna armoa
programme.desc: Denzel Washington on pääosassa tässä mukaansatempaavassa trillerissä. Hän esittää pikkukaupungin poliisipäällikköä, joka joutuu myrskyn silmään tutkiessaan salaa tapailemansa naisen murhaa… koska kaikki todisteet viittaavat häneen!

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: Liity tähtitieteen professorin matkaan, kun hän kilpailee aikaa vastaan ​​pelastaakseen perheensä maata kohti suuntautuvalta katastrofaaliselta asteroidilta yrittäen samalla varoittaa maailmaa. Selviytyykö ihmiskunta?

programme.title: Reunalla
programme.desc: Uskallatko ottaa seuraavan askeleen? Vankikarkuri Nick Cassidy ilmestyy yhtäkkiä pilvenpiirtäjän reunukselle New Yorkissa. Aikooko hän hypätä?

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan.

programme.title: Gods Of Egypt
programme.desc: Tässä muinaisen Egyptin mytologiasta ammentavassa toimintaseikkailussa koko ihmiskunnan tulevaisuus on vaakalaudalla, kun tavallinen kuolevainen Bek nousee sankariksi ryhtyessään pelastamaan maailmaa ja tosirakkauttaan.

programme.title: Bandidas
programme.desc: 1800-luvun lopun Meksiko on todellinen paheiden pesä, jossa raha sanelee säännöt. Sara on rikkaan pankkiirin tytär, kun taas Maria on köyhä talonpoikaisnainen.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: Kin, pulssia kohottava rikostrilleri scifivivahteilla, on tarina yllättävästä sankarista matkalla kohti merkittäviä tekoja.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Keskiajan historia kirjoitetaan uudelleen, kun Jamal Walker putoaa Medieval World -teemapuiston vallihautaan ja huomaa siirtyneensä ajassa taaksepäin.

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen.

programme.title: Prey
programme.desc: Nuorenparin täytyy paeta lähetyssaarnaaja-asemaltaan Kalaharin autiomaassa, kun sotilaallinen äärijärjestö uhkaa heitä. Mutta kun heidän koneensa tippuu villieläinten suojelualueelle, heidän täytyy taistella henkensä edestä.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: Monet ovat jahdanneet noitia vuosisatojen ajan eri puolilla maailmaa. Yksi heistä on urhea soturi Kaulder, joka onnistui tappamaan vahvan Kuningatarnoidan ja tuhoamaan samalla tämän joukot...

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Lahjakas uhkapeluri Michael saa viikon aikaa maksaa rikolliselle yhtiölle, muuten hänet tapetaan. Hän kerää joukon yliluonnollisia kykyjä omaavia voittaakseen suuren summan rahaa kasinolla, mutta vastustaja onkin odotettua vahvempi. Edessä on täysin uusi maailma ystävien voimien avulla.

programme.title: Hamekyttä 2
programme.desc: Hamekytän villissä jatko-osassa Martin Lawrence ja Nia Long palaavatviihdyttämään koko perhettä. Kansakunnan turvallisuus on uhattuna ja FBI-agenttiMalcolm Turner in on jälleen kerran...

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: Loppuunpalaneen yksityisen turva-agentin on määrä kuljettaa arvokas kiinalainen antiikkiesine ulos Shanghaista, mutta matkan varrelle tulee vastoinkäymisiä.

programme.title: Ullakkojengi (Aliens in the Attic)
programme.desc: Vihdoinkin kesäloma – mutta Pearsonin lapset ovat jumissa tylsällä mökillä. Kunnes ärhäkät pienet avaruusoliot laskeutuvat katolle suunnitellen mökin JA maailman valloitusta, ja nuorten on yhdistettävä voimansa ja videopelitaitonsa pelastaakseen maailman!

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa ja Rose ovat 17-vuotiaita tyttöjä, jotka käyvät lukiota monien muiden 17-vuotiaiden tapaan. He eroavat muista siten, että Lissa juo verta ja heidän lukionsa on salainen sisäoppilaitos rauhantahtoisille Moroi-vampyyreille ja heidän suojelijoilleen!

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Onko hän lopun alkua ihmiskunnalle? Tohtori Will Caster on yksi johtavista tekoälyn tutkijoista, mutta hänen kiistanalaiset kokeensa ovat tuoneet hänelle monta vihollista.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3
programme.desc: Eletään 1600-luvun alkua feodaaliajan Japanissa, ja ratsain kulkeva mies jää vangiksi taistelussaan samurairyhmää vastaan. Vajaat 400 vuotta myöhemmin toimittaja April O’Neil hankkii kirpputorilta lahjoja kilpikonnaystävilleen.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Survivor on sähäkkä vakoiluelokuva Kate Abbottista, joka saa siirron Yhdysvaltain suurlähetystöön Lontooseen. Hänen tehtävänään on varmistaa, ettei terroristeille myönnetä viisumeja Yhdysvaltoihin. Erikoislaatuinen tehtävä tekee Abbottista silmätikun ja maalitaulun.

programme.title: Pete Smalls Is Dead
programme.desc: Hollywoodin taakseen jättänyt käsikirjoittaja joutuu palaamaan unelmien kaupunkiin ohjaajaystävänsä kuoltua.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: Kun ulkoavaruuden oliot ovat hallinneet maailmaa lähes kymmenen vuotta, kapinallisten ryhmä Chicagossa käy taisteluun planeettamme puolesta muukalaisia ja heidän ihmiskätyreitään vastaan.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: Kun todistusaineisto viittaa Los Angelesissä työskentelevän poliisikonkarin syyllisyyteen kollegansa teloituksesta, hän joutuu uhmaamaan samaa poliisikulttuuria, jonka mukaisesti hän on itse toiminut koko uransa ajan.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Yritysvakoilun hämärässä valtakunnassa kyllästynyt jokamies kompastuu petoksen verkkoon ja hänestä tulee tietämätön vakooja. Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Ahkera lukiolainen Vee Delmonico on kyllästynyt olemaan varjossa. Kun kaverit painostavat osallistumaan suosittuun nettipeliin, Nerveen, Vee päättää osallistua yhteen kisaan harmitonta hupia.

programme.title: On The Edge
programme.desc: Laittomat katuajot, alkoholi ja vauhdikkaat suhteet pitävät asiat mielenkiintoisina levottomille ja adrenaliinia janoaville kaveruksille. Yhdistelmä osoittautuu kuitenkin hengenvaaralliseksi, kun Nikolaj ja hänen paras ystävänsä Martin aiheuttavat nuoren tytön kuoleman katuajoissa.
